name: Bingqilin Popup Blocker
description: Closes the popups and tab-unders that the Bingqilin player's video embeds open. Runs on the player only — never on the tools pages or anywhere else.
_comment_optional: Granted per source origin at runtime, on one click. Nothing is granted at install, and no source domain is written here — they are read from the player's own configuration and change whenever you rotate them.
